title: Receipt
description: What happened to an envelope, one entry per op. Merges Daybreak's bridge receipts (applied, skipped, refused, queued, whole-file failed) with AD Hub's outbox outcomes (duplicate, failed, unknown with reconciliation).

version.description: The id of the version (change set) the applied ops became, when they made one.

note.description: A code-written note of what changed: "From pi: added Sketch the poster · moved Deep work".

status.description: done: every op has an outcome below. pending: accepted, not processed yet (the switch is off, or paused); ops is empty. failed: the whole envelope was rejected (unreadable, too big, wrong version, a reused id with different ops); ops is empty and error says why. A reused envelope id with a different requestDigest is failed with error code idempotency_conflict (HTTP 409); the same id with the same request returns the original receipt.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: applied: done now. already-applied: this key was applied before; the earlier result is returned (Daybreak's replayed envelope, Hub's duplicate). skipped: already so, nothing to do. refused: not allowed or not understood; resend only after changing it. queued: waits for a person to keep or reject it. pending: accepted, not processed yet. failed: a clear failure, nothing changed; a retry may make a new attempt. unknown: an external call may or may not have happened; a person must reconcile it before any retry.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request, to tell a replay from a reused key.

safeError.title: SafeError
safeError.description: An error safe to show and store: no secrets, tokens, stack traces, raw payloads or personal text.

code.description: Stable machine code: not_found, ambiguous_title, too_many_ops, stale_version (HTTP 409 on a stale version), idempotency_conflict (HTTP 409: the envelope id was used before with a different request), timeout.

index.description: The op's place in the envelope (0-based); -1 for the envelope itself (Daybreak's retired top-level request).

words.description: What happened, in words for the sender.

ids.description: What the op made or acted on. Stable: derived from the envelope key and the op's index.

remoteId.description: The id an external system returned (an Asana task, a Slack message).

prior.description: For already-applied: the outcome the earlier attempt had.

attempt.description: Which attempt under this key this was (Hub's <key>#2).

decision.description: For a queued op once a person decided it.

by.description: An opaque person ref, never an email.
